title: Find the youngest driver who achieved a fastest lap speed over 200 km/h in
question: Find the youngest driver who achieved a fastest lap speed over 200 km/h in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix. Calculate this driver's average points scored across all races in 2009.

prediction.sql:
WITH YoungestDriver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS DriverId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND CAST(res.XCL_089 AS REAL) > 200
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(res.XCL_082) AS average_points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN YoungestDriver yd ON res.XCL_075 = yd.DriverId
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH YoungestDriver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS DriverId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND CAST(res.XCL_089 AS REAL) > 200
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(res.XCL_082) AS average_points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN YoungestDriver yd ON res.XCL_075 = yd.DriverId
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009

The bindings for driver_id (XCL_034), race_id (XCL_065/XCL_074), year (XCL_066), race_name (XCL_069), date_of_birth (XCL_040), fastest_lap_speed (XCL_089), and points (XCL_082) are supported by historical evidence and physical value witnesses. No semantic errors were found.
checks: Eligibility: Driver must have a result in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix with XCL_089 > 200. The CTE correctly filters for this and selects the driver with the maximum XCL_040 (youngest).

Measure: Average points (XCL_082) for the selected driver across all 2009 races. The main query joins results to races for 2009 and filters by the selected driver ID. This correctly computes the average over all 2009 race results for that driver.
Grain: The results table has one row per driver per race. The join to YoungestDriver (single row) does not change the grain. The AVG is computed over the correct set of rows.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH YoungestDriver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS DriverId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND CAST(res.XCL_089 AS REAL) > 200
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AVG(res.XCL_087)
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN YoungestDriver yd ON res.XCL_075 = yd.DriverId
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2009

SELECT AVG(r.XCL_082) AS average_points
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races race ON r.XCL_074 = race.XCL_065
JOIN seasons s ON race.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
WHERE d.XCL_034 = (
    SELECT d2.XCL_034
    FROM results r2
    JOIN drivers d2 ON r2.XCL_075 = d2.XCL_034
    JOIN races race2 ON r2.XCL_074 = race2.XCL_065
    JOIN circuits c ON race2.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN seasons s2 ON race2.XCL_066 = s2.XCL_091
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Spain'
      AND s2.XCL_092 = '2009'
      AND r2.XCL_082 > 200
    ORDER BY d2.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND s.XCL_092 = '2009'
